comment: Hand-kept (roadmap item 3, How to Watch). An event is on one or more channels (broadcasts.js); a channel is on one or more apps, per country, listed here. Julien maintains this file: add an app to a channel's list, or a channel to a country, as you find them.
rules: kind says what the app is to the channel: own (its own app), streamer (a streaming service that carries it), provider (a distributor, operator or bundle carrying many channels). A game's cards go own, then streamer, then provider; within a kind, the order here.

tvos lists the countries whose App Store has a tvOS version of the app (checked with Apple's lookup API, 2026-10-04). A card is shown only for an app with tvOS in the viewer's country: an iOS-only app cannot be opened from an Apple TV.
appStoreId is a number, or a map by country when the store's listing differs (Paramount+ in Brazil). builtIn apps (Apple TV) have none.
A channel is found by its exact name, then without a trailing number (Ligue 1+ 4 -> Ligue 1+, ESPN 3 -> ESPN), then without a trailing 'Max N' (beIN Sports Max 7 -> beIN Sports Max).
Never a link to a stream; only an official broadcaster's or distributor's app (AGENTS.md rule 4).

The first version privileges the main, official app: an app is a card only when an official source says it plays that channel; what is only inferred is left out until someone has seen it on a real Apple TV (Julien, 2026-10-04). The page shows at most four cards, in the order own, streamer, provider.

A competition's own app (competitions) is a complement: it goes after the channels' apps, keeps the last of the four places, and is shown for every country listed, whether or not a channel of that country carries the game.

schemes lists URL schemes to try, in order, to open the app from the Apple TV (UIApplication.open); they are guesses until the app's Open apps test (Settings) says which work, and the App Store page is the fallback. An app with none is opened only by its store page.

Claro tv+ lineup: claro.com.br/blog/tv/assistir-futebol-ao-vivo (ESPN, SporTV, BandSports, GE TV in the plan; Premiere, Paramount+ add-ons; HBO Max and Prime Video on new plans)
Vivo Play: sports channels not in the app (tecnoblog.net); removed from every list

The CANAL+ Sport pack carries CANAL+ Sport, CANAL+ Foot, beIN SPORTS 1-10 (so Max 4-10 are on the CANAL+ app), Eurosport 1, 2 and 360, Multisports 1, Golf+
myCANAL is on Apple TV (and Apple's lookup lists a tvOS CANAL+ app in France)
2026-10-04 (third search): Fandango: the Bundesliga's US rights are Versant's from 2026-27 — 30+ games on USA Network, the other 275+ free on Fandango's ad-supported streaming (insidersport.com, heavy.com, sportcal.com)

SKY+ (Brazil): packs carry ESPN, ESPN Brasil, SporTV 1-3, Premiere, BandSports, Fox Sports, with HBO Max, Prime, Paramount+ and Disney+ in the bigger ones; the SKY+ app plays live channels on a smart TV (minhaconexao.com.br, melhorplano.net, opovo.com.br)
2026-10-04 (Brazil, with Julien): Julien: the main ways to watch in Brazil are Globoplay, Vivo, Claro, SKY+ and the channel's own app

Apple's store, Brazil: Premiere (468481865) has a tvOS app; Vivo's TV app is 'Vivo TV' (589412933, tvOS), not 'Vivo Play'; ge globo (361393520) has one too; Conmebol Libertadores, SportyNet, BandSports, Telecine and Oi Play have none
2026-10-04 (France, with Julien): Julien: in France it is Canal+, Free, Molotov, maybe Bouygues and Orange

Apple's store, France: Free TV (1542614107) and b.tv par Bouygues Telecom (739824309) have a tvOS app; Orange and SFR have none for their TV service (RMC Sport, SFR's, has); nothing found for 'Wake Television'
2026-10-04 (store charts, FR/US/BR): Top-free iPhone charts, Entertainment and Sports, 100 each per country, kept to apps with a tvOS version: they confirm the picks (FR: CANAL+ #25, Free TV #42, Molotov #53, b.tv #81; BR: Globoplay #12, Premiere #17 in Sports, Claro tv+ #56) and add, for the US, Watch TNT, DIRECTV, Spectrum TV and Hulu + Live TV
Not mapped on purpose: F1 TV (a service for the sport, not a channel in the feed; idea: a competition-level 'also on' card), OneFootball, MLB, NHL, CBS Sports, Pluto, Tubi, Netflix, Crunchyroll
2026-10-04 (SKY+, with Julien): SKY+ in Brazil is the old DIRECTV GO app: one app, id 6467130144, tvOS; a search of the news for 'DirecTV Go' (70+ channels, R$ 79.90, no mobile or broadband plan needed) describes the same product
2026-10-04 (three research agents, one p: US: the FOX Sports app stopped working on Apple TV on 2026-05-07 (its own store text; foxsports.com FAQ): FOX One replaces it. Fox Soccer Plus is not in FOX One. Fubo no longer has USA Network (Versant channels left in 2025); USA Network has its own app (661695783). NFL Network belongs to ESPN (in ESPN Unlimited). DIRECTV's lineup of 2026-07-29 carries NBA TV, TUDN, Universo, Univision, Fox Deportes, ESPN Deportes, Tennis Channel, FS2, not beIN or Fox Soccer Plus. The Bundesliga is Versant's (USA Network, free games on Fandango).

FR: Orange has an Apple TV app, Orange TV (6504527377): beIN, Ligue 1+, Eurosport, TF1, France 2/3, M6, L'Équipe, not Canal+. Canal+ stopped carrying DAZN on 2025-07-31. b.tv (Bouygues) does not play the Canal+ channels (its channel PDF of 2026-09-01). Eurosport streams through HBO Max in France (HBO Max has an Apple TV app there). Disney+ carries the L'Équipe channel and the LaLiga games. beIN SPORTS CONNECT is played in the CANAL+ app. RMC Sport + Ligue 1+ is not confirmed this season (ligue1.com lists no RMC Sport as a partner). 'Wake Television' is probably Waka TV, an unlicensed IPTV: out under rule 4.

BR: Vivo TV is the former Vivo Play. Claro tv+ carries Globo, ESPN 1-6, SporTV 1-3, TNT, BandSports, SportyNet, NSports, XSports, GE TV; HBO Max and Paramount+ are separate subscriptions that play in their own apps (so no Claro card). SKY+ names ESPN, SporTV, TNT and finds Premiere by search. Disney+ has the ESPN channels in Premium only. The ge app's tvOS build is from 2021: not used.
2026-10-04 (CazéTV, with Julien): CazéTV is a YouTube channel and, through a partnership with Amazon since 2024, also in Prime Video (simulcast of the whole 2026 World Cup, Libertadores and more); the Paulistão, the Copinha and the Brasileirão are YouTube-only (Meio&Mensagem, goal.com, gameoverdrive.com.br). YouTube first because everyone has it and it plays every game; a per-competition exception could drop the Prime Video card for the Brasileirão later.
2026-10-04 (Julien: privilege the main o: Left out for now, to add back when seen on a real TV: BR Premiere: Claro tv+ (an add-on; that it plays inside the tvOS app is unverified); FR Canal+: Free TV (inferred, not in Free's list); FR Canal+ Foot: Free TV (inferred, not in Free's list); FR Canal+ Sport: Free TV (inferred, not in Free's list); FR Canal+ Sport 360: Free TV (inferred, not in Free's list); US Universo: Telemundo app (unverified); US Tennis Channel: Fubo (unclear)
2026-10-04 (open questions searched agai: BR: Premiere plays inside Claro tv+: Claro's own page says clients with Premiere in their plan can watch the Brasileirão and the Copa do Brasil finals 'direto na Claro tv+', in the app, on TV and on the web, with Apple TV among the supported devices (claro.com.br/blog/tv/assistir-futebol-ao-vivo; dplnews.com) — Claro tv+ is back on Premiere

FR: Ligue 1+ 2026-27 is distributed by 'Orange, Bouygues Telecom, Free, SFR, DAZN, Prime Video, RMC Sport, Molotov et OneFootball, mais pas par Canal+' (ariase.com, summer 2026) — RMC Sport is back on Ligue 1+

FR: Freebox subscribers with a Canal+ offer use the myCANAL app on Apple TV with their Freebox login (universfreebox.com): the Canal+ channels are in the CANAL+ app, not in Free TV — the removal stands

FR: Orange TV carries beIN SPORTS 1-3, Ligue 1+ and Eurosport 1 (phonandroid.com, selectra.info); beIN plays on every TV connected to the Livebox. FR: the L'Équipe app on Apple TV has the live channel (since 2017; the 2019 build may be stale)

US: Fandango's Bundesliga is free, with no login, in the Fandango app on a connected TV (techradar.com, inquirer.com). Fubo has NFL Network, ESPN, FS1, FS2 and beIN (Pro), and lacks TNT, TBS and truTV; it restored NBC in September 2026 (cabletv.com, fantasynerds.com). The Telemundo app lists Universo among the networks it shows with a TV-provider login, a Peacock subscription does not count; whether Universo plays live there is not stated

Not found anywhere: whether SporTV and Globo play inside Vivo TV (Vivo's page says SporTV is in its closed lineup, available with a TV package; an older article says Vivo Play had no Apple TV app, the store now lists Vivo TV for tvOS); Globo live in SKY+; whether the NBC Sports app still plays USA Network
2026-10-04 (NBA and NFL apps, with Julie: NBA League Pass is on Apple TV in France (basket-mag.com: standard €149.99 a year, premium, team pass; all games) and the NBA app has a tvOS build in the US, France and Brazil; NFL: in the US the NFL app, outside it NFL Game Pass International through DAZN (every game, RedZone, NFL Network), and DAZN has a tvOS app in France, the US and Brazil

toConfirm: Still unknown after searching (for when someone has the account on a real Apple TV): BR whether SporTV and Globo play inside Vivo TV with a TV package; BR Globo live in SKY+; FR whether the 2019 L'Équipe tvOS build still plays the live channel; FR Orange TV on an Apple TV (beIN, Ligue 1+); US whether the NBC Sports app still plays USA Network; US whether Universo plays live in the Telemundo app; US Fubo's Tennis Channel and NBA TV. None blocks the first version.

lequipe.name: L'Équipe
lequipe.note: Its tvOS build is 1.2 of 2019-02-19: it may not open the live channel or Ligue 1+. Unverified in practice.

skyplus.name: SKY+
skyplus.note: Brazil. The former DIRECTV GO app (Julien; Apple's store returns it for 'DIRECTV GO', first released 2023-11-28): live channels and on-demand, SKY satellite subscribers use the same app. Plans: SKY+ Light / Full, Canais e Streamings II, Futebol, Canais e Futebol (R$ 79,90-219,90). Premiere is opened by searching inside it (SKY+ FAQ).

vivotv.name: Vivo TV
vivotv.note: Brazil. The former Vivo Play app, renamed Vivo TV on 2025-10-03 (Vivo's notice; same id 589412933). App-only plans (Inicial, Estendido): ESPN 1-4 (5-6 in Estendido), TNT, BandSports, open channels. SporTV only with the TV packages (Avançado, Completo); Globo only in 14 cities. No Premiere: Vivo sends Premiere subscribers to the Premiere and Globoplay apps.

orangetv.name: Orange TV
orangetv.note: Made only for Apple TV (launched 2024-07). Needs the Orange option for connected TVs (free with Livebox Up/Max). Orange's channel list marks beIN 1-10, Ligue 1+ 1-9, Eurosport 1/2/360, TF1, France 2/3, M6 and L'Équipe as watchable outside the box; Canal+ channels are not.

competitions.comment: A league's own all-games app, added after the channels' apps to every country listed (Julien, 2026-10-04: 'the NBA app and the NFL app have all the games, a good complement'). Keyed by the competition's TheSportsDB id. NBA League Pass is in the NBA app in France and Brazil too (basket-mag.com 2026-27: standard, premium and team pass on Apple TV); outside the US the NFL's all-games product, NFL Game Pass International, is sold through DAZN, not the NFL app (nfl.com/DAZN, 2026).
